about: ZenEng v103, Window 123, fixes 252-256. The judges and their tests. The code that defines them is in the paper's evidence folder corpus/selector/ (selector_study.py, order_study.py, combined_study.py); the definitions of the four order measures are in fix 253.

judges, ready to use.how to score a window: for each judge: replace a missing measure with fill_missing_with; z = (value - mean) / sd; log-odds = intercept + sum(weight * z). combined = (content log-odds + order log-odds) / 2. A build's score is the mean over its Verse 1 and Chorus 1 windows (8 bars from the section's own first bar).
judges, ready to use.order measures, code:
def bars_of(N):
    B = [[] for _ in range(8)]
    for n in sorted(N, key=lambda n: n[0]):
        if 0 <= n[0] < 32: B[int(n[0] // 4)].append((n[0] % 4, n[1], n[2]))
    return B

def measures(B):
    f = {}; nb = [len(b) for b in B]
    if sum(nb) < 12 or sum(1 for x in nb if x) < 5: return None
    tail = [4 - b[-1][0] if b else 4.0 for b in B]
    f["tail_even"] = np.mean([tail[i] for i in (1, 3, 5, 7)]) - np.mean([tail[i] for i in (0, 2, 4, 6)])
    f["tail_48"] = np.mean([tail[3], tail[7]]) - np.mean([tail[i] for i in (0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6)])
    f["thin_48"] = np.mean([nb[i] for i in (0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6)]) - np.mean([nb[3], nb[7]])
    inside, across = [], []; prev = None
    for b in B:
        for k, (t, d, p) in enumerate(b):
            if prev is not None: (across if k == 0 else inside).append(abs(p - prev))
            prev = p
    f["smooth_barline"] = (np.mean(inside) - np.mean(across)) if inside and across else np.nan
    allnotes = [n for b in B for n in b]; last = next(b for b in reversed(B) if b)[-1]; f["last_long"] = last[1] / np.median([n[1] for n in allnotes])
    on = [frozenset(int(round(t * 4)) for t, d, p in b) for b in B]; pm = [{int(round(t * 4)): p for t, d, p in b} for b in B]
    jac = lambda a, b: len(a & b) / len(a | b) if (a | b) else np.nan
    def psame(i, j):
        sh = set(pm[i]) & set(pm[j]); return np.mean([pm[i][s] == pm[j][s] for s in sh]) if len(sh) >= 2 else np.nan
    par = {(0, 2), (1, 3), (4, 6), (5, 7), (0, 4), (1, 5), (2, 6), (3, 7)}; allp = [(i, j) for i in range(8) for j in range(i + 1, 8)]
    f["parallel"] = np.nanmean([jac(on[i], on[j]) for i, j in par]) - np.nanmean([jac(on[i], on[j]) for i, j in allp if (i, j) not in par])
    a, b_ = [psame(i, j) for i, j in par], [psame(i, j) for i, j in allp if (i, j) not in par]; f["pitch_parallel"] = (np.nanmean(a) - np.nanmean(b_)) if np.isfinite(a).any() and np.isfinite(b_).any() else np.nan
    mp = [np.mean([p for t, d, p in b]) if b else np.nan for b in B]; f["arch_units"] = np.nanmean([mp[i] for i in (0, 2, 4, 6)]) - np.nanmean([mp[i] for i in (1, 3, 5, 7)])
    f["end_low"] = np.nanmean(mp) - next(x for x in reversed(mp) if x == x)
    return f
